name: Dying With Cry
source:
Noah, a private investigator, reflects on an old case while searching for a missing family. 
Six years ago in Najamo he was involved in a dispute between a shady organization. 
Things went bad and there was a terrible explosion. The case was closed, but his gut never let go. 
Now, he returns to Najamo in search of his lost partner, Ukon, who was as close as a brother. 
Noah meets a man named Marley, an old agent of the NSA who he thought had died six years ago. 
If Marley is alive, then so is hope. So is Ukon. 
Marley begins to tell him the whole, true story. 
And Noah has a revelation of sorrow.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE104009.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
私家侦探诺亚在寻找失踪家庭时回顾了一起旧案。
六年前，在纳贾莫，他卷入了一个可疑组织之间的纠纷。
事情变得很糟并且发生了可怕的爆炸。案子已经结案了，但他的内心却从未放松过。
现在，他回到纳贾莫寻找他失去的伙伴乌孔，他就像兄弟一样亲密。
诺亚遇到了一个名叫马利的人，他是国家安全局的一名老特工，他认为他已经在六年前去世了。
如果马利还活着，那么希望也还活着。宇康亦是如此。
马利开始告诉他整个真实的故事。
挪亚也流露出悲伤的情绪。
